name_reason: Already compliant: data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> with the battle core convention (data_fd2_battle_*), no Ghidra address residue. 'phase' correctly reflects an enumerated multi-state value (0..6) rather than a boolean flag; it is the right descriptor. Home file field/chinit.c owns battle-engine globals so the battle domain tag is appropriate. No rename needed.
purpose: Battle/field cursor-overlay mode selector: a single uint32 that picks which cursor highlight / range-indicator pattern fd2_paint_cursor_overlay_pattern draws and gates cursor redraw + per-step animation pulses.
logic_summary: Unsigned 32-bit scalar, values 0..6 observed across all 167 reference sites. Writers assign 0/1/6 as immediates (others store a computed/restored value); readers CMP against 0,1,2,3,4,5,6. 0=idle/no overlay (cursor steppers skip the immediate composite redraw, paint draws nothing); 1=plain cursor box (sprite 0); 2=alternate single cursor sprite (sprite 1); 3=manhattan-range-1 ring (5 sprites); 4=manhattan-range-2 area (13 sprites); 5=manhattan-range-3 area (21 sprites); 6=clear cursor flag from tile map and act as a no-pulse sentinel in fd2_pan_cursor_to_tile_animated (phase!=0 && !=6 gates the per-step wait). fd2_wait_for_action_target_input reads it as a range hint: (phase>1 ? phase-1 : phase) feeds fd2_scan_chars_within_manhattan_range radius, mapping ring phases 3/4/5 to scan radius 2/3/4. Canonical envelope sets 0 before and 1 after fd2_run_full_turn_cycle; fd2_set_battle_anim_phase_to_1 is the dedicated '=1' setter. Widely written by chapter NN init/end handlers (cutscene phase markers, reset to 0 after dialog pages), AI turn logic, menu/dialog loops, and spell effects.
datatype: uint32 (4-byte dword scalar; standalone, not an array -- 0x51a87 is a separate symbol data_fd2_battle_view_window_max_x)
element_semantics: Enumerated cursor-overlay mode/phase: 0=idle(no overlay,defer redraw), 1=plain cursor box, 2=alt cursor sprite, 3=range-1 ring, 4=range-2 area, 5=range-3 area, 6=clear-cursor/no-pulse sentinel.
comment_original_issue: Both the src definition comment and the Ghidra comment were materially inaccurate: they called it a 'flag', said it 'toggles between 0 and 1', and claimed 'only compared == 0 / assigned 0 or 1'. Exhaustive scan of all 167 refs shows writes of 0/1/6 and compares against 0,1,2,3,4,5,6, selecting distinct cursor-overlay patterns (fd2_paint_cursor_overlay_pattern). Additionally the Ghidra comment lived in PRE_COMMENT (wrong field for a data plate per project rule) and carried a stale emit hint naming the symbol 'battle_anim_phase'.
notes: src comment rewritten to document the full 0..6 phase enumeration (Edit only, single block). Ghidra plate corrected and moved from PRE_COMMENT to PLATE_COMMENT (data-plate mechanism per memory project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism); stale PRE_COMMENT cleared; FD2.LE saved. name kept (no Stage-2 rename). No bad-instruction bookmark risk (no code/type change). Other chinit.c chapter-handler comments that mention this global describe writing 0 and remain accurate -- left untouched.
